newsitem.title: USA: Radioshack to have full-service Sprint stores.
newsitem.headline: Radioshack to have full-service Sprint stores.

text.p: Sprint Corp., Tandy Corp.'s RadioShack division and Sprint Spectrum said Wednesday they have entered a marketing pact to create a "store-within-a-store" of Sprint-branded products in RadioShack stores.

The stores will have a full service communications information centre offering Sprint Spectrum digital wireless services, Sprint long distance, local and wireless phone service, Internet access and paging, as well as Sprint's Spree brand prepaid phone cards and phone sets.
Sprint Spectrum is a partnership of Sprint, Tele-Communications Inc., Cox Communications Inc. and Comcast Corp.
The 6,800 RadioShack stores will also be the exclusive retailer of Sprint-branded home telephones.
RadioShack will be one of the first retail locations where Sprint Spectrum will sell its new digital wireless service.
Sprint Spectrum plans to launch its nationwide, digital wireless service in 15 to 20 markets by year end and in the remainder of its 32 major trading areas in the first quarter of 1997.

"Sprint, Sprint Spectrum and RadioShack will offer to consumers a complete package of customised consumer products, simply and conveniently, in a familiar store in their neighbourhood," Sprint Chief Executive William Esrey said.
The three companies "share a strategic vision of one-stop telephone shopping that cannot be readily duplicated," said Tandy Chief Executive John V. Roach.

Sprint-branded PCS products and services are expected to be available in some 300 RadioShack stores in about 15 cities by year end. The full line of Sprint products and services is expected to be available in as many as 4,500 additional stores in 1997, the companies said.
